June 27, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Benin Management Corp decreased its stake in Abbott Labs (ABT) by 32.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Benin Management Corp sold 17,725 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.04% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,405 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.24M, down from 55,130 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Benin Management Corp who had been investing in Abbott Labs for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $106.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $60.81. About 3.70M shares traded. Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) has risen 41.91% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending.
